title: fix: ViewConfigPanel semantic alignment, interaction tests, config sync integration tests, and ROADMAP update
body:
Issue #724 follow-up: completes all remaining semantic alignment, i18n verification, test coverage, and ROADMAP updates for ViewConfigPanel spec compliance.

### 1. Semantic Field Consistency

- **`editRecordsInline` → `inlineEdit`**: Renamed `data-testid="toggle-editRecordsInline"` → `"toggle-inlineEdit"`, i18n key `console.objectView.editRecordsInline` → `console.objectView.inlineEdit` in ViewConfigPanel.tsx
- **All 10 i18n locale files** (en, zh, de, ru, ja, fr, ar, pt, es, ko) — renamed key `editRecordsInline` → `inlineEdit`
- **ViewConfigPanel.test.tsx** — updated all assertions and test names to match new testid
- **ROW_HEIGHT_OPTIONS** already uses `compact/medium/tall` — verified, no changes needed
- `ObjectView.tsx` retains backward-compat fallback: `viewDef.inlineEdit ?? viewDef.editRecordsInline ?? listSchema.inlineEdit`

### 2. i18n Key Completeness

- Verified en.ts and zh.ts have 109 identical keys in `console.objectView` section
- Added missing `viewTabs` key to both en.ts and zh.ts
- All issue-specified keys verified present: navigation, selection, pagination, export, searchableFields, filterableFields, resizable, densityMode, hiddenFields, rowActions, bulkActions, sharing, addRecord, conditionalFormatting, quickFilters, showRecordCount, allowPrinting, virtualScroll, emptyState, aria, userFilters, viewTabs

### 3. Tests and Acceptance

- **11 new ViewConfigPanel interaction tests** for previously render-only controls: emptyState title/message/icon, ARIA label/describedBy/live, rowActions, bulkActions, showRecordCount, allowPrinting, virtualScroll
- **9 new config sync integration tests** in `config-sync-integration.test.tsx` covering Phase 7 scenarios:
  - Per-view-type: Grid, Kanban, Calendar, Timeline, Gantt, Gallery, Map
  - Cross-view-type config transfer test
  - Full P0/P1/P2 property propagation test (40+ properties verified)
- Full test suite: **962 passed, 0 failed** (70 test files, 2 pre-existing skipped, no `.only`)

### 4. ROADMAP Update

- Marked Phase 2–7 integration test items as ✅
- Updated ⚠️ warning about missing per-view-type integration tests to ✅ complete

> 
> ---
> 
> ## 1. 语义字段一致性修复
> 
> ### 1.1 `editRecordsInline` → `inlineEdit`
> - 【必要】将 ViewConfigPanel 及相关配置、draft 写入与 `updateDraft('editRecordsInline', ...)` 等相关逻辑重命名为 `inlineEdit`
> - Console ObjectView 目前已兼容 `inlineEdit` 与旧字段，但仍要将控件、存储、类型全部统一改为 `inlineEdit`
> - 扫描所有引用（包括变量、props、测试、类型定义、data-testid等）
> - 批量更新测试用例（建议：保持所用 data-testid 与一线 name 保持一致）
> 
> ### 1.2 rowHeight value 规范（short→compact）
> - 【必���】`ROW_HEIGHT_OPTIONS` 由 [`short`, `medium`, `tall`, `extraTall`] 改为 [`compact`, `medium`, `tall`]
> - 控制面板、控件、schema存储、下游消费全部用 spec 定义值
> - 清理/迁移 legacy "short"/"extraTall"相关代码和测试
> 
> ---
> 
> ## 2. i18n 多语种 key 校验
> - 检查所有新增控件的 i18n keys （en.json、zh.json）是否完整，有遗漏及时补全
> - 优先覆盖：navigation、selection、pagination、export、searchableFields、filterableFields、resizable、densityMode、hiddenFields、rowActions、bulkActions、sharing、addRecord、conditionalFormatting、quickFilters、showRecordCount、allowPrinting、virtualScroll、emptyState、aria、userFilters、viewTabs
> - 用脚本扫描自动校对所有 data-testid 涉及的文案key
> - 两语种都需补全（英/中文）
> 
> ---
> 
> ## 3. 测试与验收
> - 检查 ViewConfigPanel.test.tsx 覆盖率，补充 P1/P2 控件的所有数据流/事件/控件渲染用例，保证每种配置至少有 snapshot/交互/提交覆盖
> - ListView/PluginObjectView 层需补充单元与集成测试，覆盖所有配置项 passthrough、render、响应
> - 针对所有视图类型（Grid/Kanban/Calendar/Timeline/Gallery/Map/Gantt）补全 config sync 的集成测试（ROADMAP P1.8.1 Phase 7 所列 6 大场景）
> - 自动化运行全量测试（pnpm test），确认覆盖率 >= 90%、无残留 skip/only、所有功能性用例通过
> 
> ---
> 
> ## 4. 开发流程规范
> - 本 issue 开发完毕 & 测试通过后：须同步 update ROADMAP.md，将所有相关条目状态更新为 ✅，并简要说明修复内容与「语义/验收对齐」结论
